_readme: Every factual marketing claim lives here. A claim renders on the site ONLY when "verified": true. Unverified claims are hidden in production builds and shown as dashed TODO chips in `npm run dev` so you can review them. Before setting verified=true, make sure you can back the claim up (contracts, monitoring data, certificates, client consent).
